message:
test_command_line_tool_runner: abort the test slot on a failed completion check

expectSingleCompletion() used QTest check macros inside a helper
function; on failure they return from the helper only, so the test slot
carried on into completionSucceeded(), which indexes an empty
QSignalSpy. The suite segfaulted instead of reporting the failure,
taking the remaining tests in the binary with it.

The helper is now a macro, so a failed check returns from the calling
test slot itself: the failure is reported cleanly and the rest of the
suite still runs.

Verified by injecting a forced failure into a scratch copy: before,
FAIL! followed by SIGSEGV with the remaining tests never executed;
after, a clean FAIL! with all other tests still running and a non-zero
exit. The unmodified suite passes 9/9.

Fixes #1318
